details:
RIDGE Alert is an interactive astronaut health monitoring and wellness platform designed to support physical and emotional well-being during long-duration space missions. Our goal was to create a system that makes health information easier to understand while helping astronauts maintain a sense of connection to Earth.

NASA identifies five major hazards of human spaceflight: space radiation, isolation and confinement, distance from Earth, altered gravity, and hostile or closed environments. These conditions can affect cardiovascular health, sleep, cognitive performance, and emotional well-being. As astronauts travel farther from Earth, communication delays and limited access to immediate medical assistance make independent health awareness increasingly important.

To address these challenges, we developed RIDGE Alert, a web-based application that combines health monitoring, wellness tracking, and emotional support in one accessible interface.

Our platform features a personalized health dashboard where astronauts can view heart rate, blood oxygen saturation, sleep duration, and mood. Inspired by modern wellness applications such as Oura, we designed circular health scores, interactive graphs, and collapsible monitoring sections to make health information visually understandable without overwhelming the user.

Astronauts can manually enter health measurements and explore trends through graphs. The current prototype uses simulated health data to demonstrate how changes in physical well-being could be monitored over time. These measurements and wellness scores are illustrative rather than clinically validated.

RIDGE Alert also includes a Current Recommendations section featuring wellness activities such as exercise, sleep monitoring, and mood check-ins. These recommendations demonstrate how a future system could encourage healthy routines and support astronauts in managing their daily well-being.

One of our most important features is Messages From Earth. While astronaut health monitoring often focuses on physical measurements, we wanted to recognize the psychological challenges of isolation and separation from loved ones. This section demonstrates how astronauts could receive encouraging messages from family and friends. Our future vision includes scheduled birthday messages, personalized photographs, and offline access to previously downloaded content, helping astronauts maintain emotional connections even when communication with Earth is limited.

We also developed a demonstration Flight Surgeon Portal that displays selected astronaut health measurements from a medical monitoring perspective. In future versions, authorized flight surgeons could review health trends, communicate with astronauts, and provide personalized recommendations through secure accounts.

For the technical implementation, we used Python as our primary programming language and Streamlit to develop the interactive web application. Pandas and Streamlit's visualization tools support our health graphs and data displays, while HTML and CSS help customize the interface. We developed the project using Visual Studio Code and used Git and GitHub for version control and sharing our source code. ChatGPT assisted with programming, debugging, interface development, and documentation.

Our approach is creative because it combines the functionality of a medical monitoring portal with the accessibility of a consumer wellness application and the emotional support of a family communication platform. Instead of treating astronaut health as a collection of isolated medical measurements, RIDGE Alert considers physical health, psychological well-being, and personal connection as interconnected parts of human performance.

During development, we prioritized accessibility, readability, simplicity, and astronaut independence. We also considered privacy, communication delays, limited connectivity, and the importance of distinguishing simulated measurements from validated medical information. These considerations will guide future development of secure accounts, offline functionality, sensor integration, and medically validated anomaly detection.

Our intended impact is to explore how astronaut health technology can become more personalized, understandable, and supportive during increasingly demanding missions. RIDGE Alert is currently an educational prototype rather than an operational medical system, but it demonstrates how different aspects of astronaut well-being could be integrated into one platform.

Ultimately, we believe that advancing human space exploration requires more than developing technology capable of reaching distant destinations. It also requires developing systems that support the people making those journeys possible.

RIDGE Alert: Your Health. Your Mission. Your Connection to Earth.
